free_tier.stated: dead: the service shut down on March 31, 2026. Former offer, from third-party listings: Free 25 GB storage and 250GB outbound transfer
free_tier.notes: the former figures come from a third-party list entry removed in January 2026 with the message 'Tebi.io will be shut down'; no first-party pricing page answers.

per_object_cap.stated: unknown: the service is shut down and no first-party limits page answers
per_object_cap.notes: tebi.io has no A record and www.tebi.io answers NXDOMAIN.

retention.stated: the service ended on March 31, 2026; the shutdown notice asked users to transfer their data to another provider to avoid data loss
retention.notes: the notice text is known from copies posted by its recipients.

egress.terms: none: the S3 endpoint s3.tebi.io answers NXDOMAIN. Former offer, from third-party listings: 250GB outbound transfer free a month

interface_detail: S3-compatible object storage, per the third-party listing; the endpoint hostname s3.tebi.io no longer resolves
tooling: none works: the S3 endpoint does not resolve
chaining: none: the service is shut down; it was an S3 origin with a free 25 GB tier.
limits_note: no limit applies to a shut-down service
binding_note: the service is gone, so no limit binds

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the service is gone. A third-party guide from 2023 says the free tier plus pay-as-you-go plan needed a credit card, and an account without one got a 14-day trial.

reliability_note: shut down on March 31, 2026: s3.tebi.io and www.tebi.io answer NXDOMAIN and the apex has no A record
confidence_note: the death is measured by DNS queries on 2026-10-30 (NXDOMAIN for s3.tebi.io and www.tebi.io, no A record for tebi.io) and dated by copies of the vendor's shutdown notice posted by recipients; no first-party page answers.

evidence.proved: the S3 endpoint s3.tebi.io does not exist in DNS: Status 3 (NXDOMAIN), SOA from the tebi.io zone
www.tebi.io does not exist in DNS: Status 3 (NXDOMAIN)
the tebi.io apex answers with no A record: an Authority SOA only, no Answer section
a recipient's copy of the vendor's notice dates the shutdown to March 31, 2026
evidence.quote: Unfortunately, we are forced to shut down the Tebi.io project on March 31, 2026

evidence.proved: the notice asked users to move their data before the shutdown
evidence.quote: We ask that you transfer your data to another provider as soon as possible to avoid data loss.

evidence.proved: a second recipient quotes the notice subject naming the March 31 shutdown
evidence.quote: Tebi: project shut down on March 31

evidence.proved: the free-for-dev list removed Tebi because it would be shut down
the former free tier was 25 GB of S3-compatible storage and 250 GB of outbound transfer

evidence.quote: Only thing you will need to do is to enter your credit card to get this free tier + Pay As You Go plan.

notes: S3-compatible object storage: rejected, the service shut down on 2026-03-31. The tebi.io zone is still delegated (SOA at Hetzner DNS) but holds no host records for the site or the endpoint.
